children.value: > Fact From Story: Israel’s tech ecosystem has well proven its resilience in past conflicts with Hamas.

> Fact From Story: Israel is focused on deep tech, semiconductors, AI, mobility, fintech, cybersecurity, quantum, agtech, the cloud, devops, clean energy and so much more and as the future unrolls, these areas will grow in importance and Israel will continue to play a leading role in all of them.
> > Fact From Story: Technology is, without question, a giant part of Israel’s economy.
> > > Fact From Story: In 2022, it contributed more than 18% of the country’s GDP, the most of any single sector, according to the latest annual report from the Israel Innovation Authority.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: GDP is a measure of a country's economy.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A country's economy is important to that country.
> Commonsense Knowledge: An ecosystem that has proven its resilience in the past will remain resilient in the future.
